My recommendation

Keep The Restoration Project free as the door, and add a $27 a month paid membership behind it

You've already built the community and the journey. The free side keeps your posts and tools. The paid side gets the two weekly live calls, the 3-part Restore program as a course, a monthly hot seat and accountability pods. It gives the men who aren't ready for coaching something to say yes to, and it shows you who's serious.

Bryan Clark, Avoidant Recovery Coach

Sound familiar?

You call it protecting your peace. Your partner calls it disappearing.

Things get tense and you go quiet. You say "it's not a big deal" and it lands like you don't care. You care. Nobody ever showed you what to do with the feeling. That's a skill, and skills can be built, one week at a time, with men who get it.

Here's what you'll learn

The Journey: three areas of restoration

01

Restore Connection

Presence · communication · curiosity · emotional availability · vulnerability

Stay engaged, start connection, communicate more openly, and let your partner see more of what's happening inside you.

02

Restore Trust

Accountability · defensiveness · conflict · repair · consistency

Hear impact without jumping to defend your intention, take real responsibility, repair disconnection and become more dependable.

03

Restore Integrity

Values · boundaries · distress tolerance · initiative · consistency

Act like the partner you want to be, especially when discomfort, frustration or old habits make it hard.

How to say what you mean, without being MEAN

Instead of"I don't know why you're so upset! It's not a big deal!"
Try this"I don't know why you're upset, but I want to understand. Can you tell me more about it?"

coachbryanclark One swap. Want the rest? They're inside The Restoration Project.

Script 1 · The videos

Talking head · 30 to 40 seconds

Hook

"Ever wonder why partners keep sending relationship videos?"

Body

"It's usually not a dig. It's the only way they know to say something without starting a fight. So they let someone else say it. The question is what you do when it lands. Most of us go quiet or get defensive. There's a third option, and you can learn it."

CTA

"I teach it twice a week, live, inside The Restoration Project. Tap below and join free."

Script 2 · My peace

Talking head · 30 to 45 seconds

Hook

"I used to call it protecting my peace."

Body

"Turns out, by protecting my peace I was destroying theirs. Going quiet felt calm to me. To the person across from me it felt like I'd left the room. Outgrowing that wasn't one big moment. It was small reps: staying, saying one honest thing, repairing after."

CTA

"If you want to practise those reps with other men, The Restoration Project is free to join. Link below."

Script 3 · Better

Talking head + text · 20 to 30 seconds

Hook

"Some men don't just want to be partners. They want to be partners better."

Body

"That's who this is for. Three areas: connection, trust, integrity. Two live sessions with me every week. A pod of guys who check in on you. For $27 a month."

CTA

"Founding-member doors are open now. Tap Sign up."
